covers.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a premium wide editorial cover for the Anvil Tools article 'Debug API Data with JSON, Base64, and Browser Tools'. Generate a complete new cover, not a screenshot. Landscape 16:9 composition, 1600 by 900 if possible. An elegant realistic 3D editorial illustration of an API debugging workbench: a slim laptop in three-quarter view with a browser-shaped window containing indented structured data lines and a pair of curly brace symbols; beside it three carefully arranged floating cards showing a small grid of CSV cells, a block of encoded data lines, and a byte/checksum comparison with two aligned rows. Fine connector paths imply checking a small payload through multiple transformations. Off-white studio backdrop, indigo and cobalt primary accents, subtle cyan details, soft natural shadows, exquisite restrained materials. The laptop and cards occupy the central two-thirds with generous clean margins, readable at thumbnail size. No title, no slogans, no brand names, no watermarks, no readable code or invented user-interface labels. Only simple symbolic braces and abstract code lines; no padlock implying security validation. A polished professional editorial image, not a flat template banner.
